title: G5 system configuration
description: Central configuration for the Gentoo install on the G5. Docs: CONFIG.md. Apply with `g5 apply`.

system.description: Used once by configure.sh when installing the base system.

locale.description: System language, e.g. de_DE.UTF-8 or en_US.UTF-8.

kernel.description: gentoo-kernel = built locally with config.d/g5.config (1000 Hz, -march=native); -bin = prebuilt, 300 Hz.

style.description: minimal = flat, top text bar, no blur/animations (fastest). glass = Liquid Glass taskbar, blur, rounded corners.

screenshot.description: opal = region + annotate; grim = plain region screenshot (Print, Super+Shift+S).

keyboard_layouts.description: XKB layouts, Alt+Shift cycles through them.

vrr.description: 0 off, 1 always, 2 fullscreen only, 3 fullscreen games only (content=game).

performance.description: Applied at boot and after resume by g5-tuning.service.

cpu_pl1_watts.description: Sustained CPU power limit (RAPL PL1). 65 avoids thermal throttling under game + stream.

cpu_dynamic_boost.description: intel_pstate hwp_dynamic_boost: clock up instantly after I/O waits.

gpu_min_clock_mhz.description: Lowest RTX 4060 core clock. 1500 = always smooth desktop (+10-15 W idle), 0 = driver default.

gaming.description: Defaults for `gaming-mode`; every value can be overridden per game with an option.

stretch.description: Default stretched render size, e.g. 1920x1440. Empty = native.

refresh.description: Refresh rate for stretched games. 0 = monitor rate minus 3 Hz (frame pacing with VRR).

cursor.description: grab = gamescope locks the mouse: camera and menus work, cursor never leaves (recommended); confine = cursor kept in the window by Hyprland, but the camera stops at the window edge in shooters; free = no restriction.

grab_keyboard.description: Game gets ALL keys incl. Super (no accidental workspace switch). Super+G inside gamescope toggles.

fan_curve.description: gbcc fan curve TEMP:PERCENT while a game runs; empty = leave fans on auto.

renice.description: GameMode priority boost (higher starves Discord's stream encoder).

governor.description: CPU governor GameMode sets while a game runs. powersave: idle cores clock down, busy cores still boost (cooler). performance: all cores stay clocked up (GameMode default, hotter).

lock_without_tunnel.description: Block all internet whenever the tunnel is down (except LAN).

bypass_apps.description: Desktop IDs that always start outside the VPN (`vpn app add ID`).

bypass_domains.description: Domains/IPv4 nets every program reaches outside the VPN (`vpn domain add X`).
